create_layoutxlm_processor: create a LayoutXLMProcessor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for document layout analysis
call_layoutxlm_processor: call the LayoutXLMProcessor to encode images, text, bounding boxes, and word labels into model inputs
get_overflowing_images: get the get_overflowing_images method to map overflowing token samples back to their corresponding images
read_model_input_names: read the model_input_names property to get the list of expected model input names for LayoutXLM
test_layoutxlm_processor_ocr: test the LayoutXLMProcessor with apply_ocr enabled to verify it rejects provided bounding boxes and word labels
